about: KING STUDIES (owner, 4 Nov 2026): the King studied the way history studies its emperors, from 1947 to 2026. FACT items are public record (sources linked). PhD hypotheses are opinions for scholars to argue, labelled as hypotheses. THE MAN IN MANNAT is a MOCKUMENTARY: every FILE is invented, every FACT box under it is real.

bazaar.title: The Storytellers' Bazaar
bazaar.lede: Qissa Khwani means the market of storytellers. For centuries caravans stopped in this Peshawar bazaar and paid men to tell stories through the night. In one small corner of it, and in a few towns of west Punjab, the men who would tell India its stories for the next hundred years were born.

people.p: Raised in Peshawar. Founder of the Kapoor dynasty and Prithvi Theatres.
Born Yusuf Khan. The Tragedy King, the first Method actor of Hindi cinema.

people.b: Kapoor Haveli, Qissa Khwani Bazaar, Peshawar · 1924
people.p: The Showman. Awaara made him a star across the Soviet Union.
Studied at Government College, Lahore. The Evergreen star.
Do Bigha Zamin, Garm Hava: the actor of the common man.
Made the television Ramayan (1987) that stopped all of India every Sunday.
Jubilee Kumar: so many of his films ran 25 weeks.
Wrote the songs of DDLJ, Pardes, Dil To Pagal Hai and Mohabbatein.
The King of Romance behind the camera. Made Darr, Dil To Pagal Hai, Veer-Zaara and Jab Tak Hai Jaan, his last film.
Poet. Wrote Chaiyya Chaiyya for Dil Se..
Bharat Kumar: the patriot of Hindi cinema.
Born a year before Partition. Superstar, then minister.

people.b: Shah Wali Qatal, Qissa Khwani, Peshawar
people.p: A Pathan and a freedom fighter in India's independence struggle. He made Delhi his home. In 1965 his son was born there: Shah Rukh Khan.

bazaar.note: In 2014 Pakistan declared the Peshawar homes of Raj Kapoor and Dilip Kumar national heritage; in 2020 the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government moved to buy them as museums.

timeline.d: The subcontinent is split in two. His father, a Pathan from Peshawar, chooses India.
Shah Rukh Khan is born on 2 November in New Delhi.
Meer Taj Mohammed Khan dies of cancer. Years later the Meer Foundation will carry his name.
Graduates in Economics from Hansraj College, Delhi University.
Doordarshan airs Fauji. He plays Abhimanyu Rai, an army commando.
His mother Lateef Fatima dies. He marries Gauri and moves to Bombay.
His first film release. Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut.
Baazigar and Darr: the hero is the villain, and India loves him.
Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge. It will play at Mumbai's Maratha Mandir for more than 1,000 weeks.
His first company, with Juhi Chawla and Aziz Mirza.
Buys the sea-facing bungalow in Bandra that becomes Mannat.
Red Chillies Entertainment, with Gauri Khan. Devdas releases.
And Main Hoon Na, Red Chillies' first production.
India's fourth-highest civilian honour.
And Kaun Banega Crorepati as host.
Buys the IPL franchise with Juhi Chawla and Jay Mehta.
Held for questioning at Newark airport in the US. He says it was because of his name.
"My name is Khan, and I am not a terrorist."
Red Chillies VFX builds India's biggest effects film of its time.

timeline.t: First IPL title · the first kiss
timeline.d: KKR win the IPL. Jab Tak Hai Jaan, Yash Chopra's last film, ends his no-kiss rule.
Named after his father; supports women survivors of acid attacks.
France makes him a Knight of the Legion of Honour. KKR win again.
He speaks about rising intolerance. Calls to boycott Dilwale; he is told to go to Pakistan.
The film fails. A silence of almost five years begins.
His family is pulled into a drugs case. In 2022 the agency drops the charges for lack of evidence.
Pathaan, Jawan, Dunki. Two of them pass ₹1,000 crore worldwide (reported).
Career award at Locarno, KKR's third title, and his first place on the Hurun India Rich List.
National Film Award for Best Actor (Jawan), his first. Met Gala debut. Hurun lists him a billionaire.
24 December 2026.

lessons.t: THE NAME · being called a terrorist
lessons.line: His father was a Pathan from Peshawar who fought for India's freedom and chose India. His son was held at Newark in 2009 for his name, and in 2015 an Indian politician compared him to a terrorist and told him to go to Pakistan. His films told his own story: Rizwan ('I am not a terrorist'), Kabir Khan (the Muslim captain called a traitor after a loss to Pakistan), Veer (22 years in a Pakistani jail), Pathaan (his own people's name, worn by India's spy).
lessons.counter: A star's roles are chosen by scripts and markets, not by his wounds.
lessons.ask: What does it do to a man to prove his loyalty for 35 years? Is grace a form of courage?
lessons.q: Where is Qissa Khwani Bazaar, his father's home?

lessons.film: DDLJ, Dil To Pagal Hai, KKHH, Mohabbatein, Veer-Zaara
lessons.line: For twenty years India read him as Krishna: the eternal lover, the open arms, love as leela, many gopis (Simran, Anjali, Pooja, Zaara).
lessons.counter: The romantic hero is a genre, not a god.
lessons.ask: Did a Muslim man become India's Krishna? What does that say about the India of 1995–2010?
lessons.q: In Dil To Pagal Hai, what is his character's name?

lessons.t: H2 · KAMA, the poster child of desire
lessons.line: The land of the Kamasutra made him its face of desire, yet he refused to kiss on screen for twenty years. The kiss came in 2012, in Yash Chopra's last film.
lessons.counter: The no-kiss rule was personal, not a statement about India.
lessons.ask: Desire without the kiss: restraint, business, or India's own contradiction?
lessons.q: In which film did he first kiss on screen?

lessons.t: H3 · RAM KA CHOLA, the robe he had to wear
lessons.line: After the 2015 intolerance storm, the boycott calls against Dilwale, the silence after Zero, and the 'Besharam Rang' saffron outrage before Pathaan, the lover returned wearing Ram's robe: the soldier, the protector, the patriot, and visits to Vaishno Devi before each 2023 release. Krishna became Ram.
lessons.counter: A star at 57 chooses action; faith and strategy are his own, not forced.
lessons.ask: Was the chola chosen or forced? Krishna to Ram: evolution or survival?
lessons.q: Which Pathaan song set off the saffron outrage in December 2022?

lessons.line: Public record: in 2021 his family was pulled into a drugs case; in 2022 the agency dropped the charges for lack of evidence; in 2023 the CBI registered a case against the officer who led the raid, alleging a ₹25 crore extortion demand from the family (allegations, under investigation).
lessons.counter: One officer's alleged conduct is not a system.
lessons.ask: When the state's own investigators are accused of trying to extort the country's biggest star, is the King the most powerful man in the room, or the most vulnerable?
lessons.q: In 2022, why were the charges dropped?

lessons.line: Dilip Kumar took a Hindu screen name. Muhammad Ali refused the draft, lost his title and came back as The Greatest. Ashoka chose dhamma after Kalinga. Shah Rukh Khan answered boycotts, silence and a family case with the biggest year in Hindi cinema, and said nothing.
lessons.ask: He never answered his critics with words, only with box office. Is silence a form of resistance?
lessons.q: Who refused the Vietnam draft and lost his title?

mock.title: THE MAN IN MANNAT
mock.lede: In our world, the King became King through love. In this world, he was made. Every FACT box is real history. Every FILE is invented. To open the next file, you must know the real history.

files.fact: On 28 December 1895 the Lumière brothers held the first paid film screening in Paris. Within twenty years governments were making war propaganda on film.
files.file: The camera was never built for entertainment. It was built to watch. The Bureau, a society of watchers with members in every capital, gave the world cinema as a gift so that the world would sit still in the dark and look where it was told. Their first rule: [[a face on a screen moves more people than an army]].
files.q: In which city was the first paid film screening?

files.fact: Yusuf Khan, born in Qissa Khwani Bazaar, made his debut in Jwar Bhata (1944) under the screen name Dilip Kumar.
files.file: The Bureau's first lesson in faces: a nation will love a man more easily if it can [[forget where he came from]]. Yusuf became Dilip. The file notes he never forgot. Fifty years later another Khan would refuse to change his name, and the Bureau would spend thirty years [[making him pay for it]].
files.q: What was Dilip Kumar's birth name?

files.fact: The India–Pakistan border was drawn by Cyril Radcliffe, a British lawyer who had never been to India, in about five weeks. Dilip Kumar and Raj Kapoor were born in Peshawar's Qissa Khwani, the Storytellers' Bazaar.
files.file: In this history, the line was not drawn by a lawyer. It was drawn by the Bureau, around one bazaar. They had studied the Storytellers' Bazaar for a century: no place on earth bred more men who could make a crowd cry. Operation Qissa moved the storytellers to Bombay to become the faces of a new nation. One storyteller's son refused to go to Bombay. He was a Pathan, a freedom fighter, and he kept [[a list of every name the Bureau had moved]]. He settled in Delhi. Codename: MEER.
files.q: Who drew the India–Pakistan border in 1947?

files.fact: J. Edgar Hoover's FBI kept a large file on Charlie Chaplin. In 1947 the Hollywood Ten were blacklisted. In 1952 Chaplin's re-entry permit to the United States was revoked while he was at sea.
files.file: Hoover did not watch the actors. He ran them. Every star in Hollywood was an asset; the blacklist was the list of those who said no. Chaplin said no, and the Bureau [[closed the door behind his ship]]. The Bureau learnt a second rule: you cannot kill a famous man, but you can [[close every door]].
files.q: In which year was Chaplin's re-entry permit revoked?

files.fact: Raj Kapoor's Awaara (1951) became a phenomenon in the Soviet Union. In the same decade the CIA secretly funded the animated film of Animal Farm (1954).
files.file: Both sides of the Cold War used films. The Bureau used Bombay as the only neutral studio on earth. Raj Kapoor's songs crossed the Iron Curtain carrying [[messages nobody could stop, because everybody was singing them]]. That is why, in this history, the song sequences were always shot abroad: [[every song abroad was a handover]].
files.q: Which Raj Kapoor film became huge in the Soviet Union?

files.fact: Shah Rukh Khan was born on 2 November 1965 in New Delhi. His father died in 1981.
files.file: MEER had a son. The Bureau watched him from the cradle: a Pathan's son from the Storytellers' Bazaar, born in the capital of the country his father chose. When MEER died in 1981, the list [[passed to the boy]]. He was fifteen.
files.q: In which year did his father die?

files.fact: In 1989 Doordarshan aired Fauji, in which he played Abhimanyu Rai, a commando in training.
files.file: The Bureau's recruitment programme, broadcast as a TV serial. The cadet's codename was ABHIMANYU, from the Mahabharata: the warrior who knew how to enter the chakravyuh, the deadly spiral formation, but [[not how to get out]]. The Bureau chose the name on purpose. They trained him to enter. Nobody taught him the way out.
files.q: In Fauji, what was his character's name?

files.fact: In 1993 he played killers and stalkers in Baazigar and Darr; audiences made him a star.
files.file: Bureau experiment 93/B: will a nation love the face of a villain? Result: yes. The report, marked [[most dangerous finding in the Bureau's history]], concludes that this face can make a crowd love anything, even its own fear. The order goes out: [[make him the lover. Never let him be the villain again]].
files.q: In which 1993 film did he play a stalker?

files.fact: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge (1995) played at Mumbai's Maratha Mandir for more than 1,000 weeks.
files.file: The longest-running operation in Bureau history. Objective: bind the Indians abroad to home through one love story. It worked too well. The Bureau lost control of the film: the fans [[would not let it leave the cinema]]. For the first time the faces belonged to the crowd, not the Bureau.
files.q: Where did DDLJ play for more than 1,000 weeks?

files.fact: In 2001 he bought the sea-facing bungalow in Bandra that became Mannat. Every 2 November thousands of fans gather outside.
files.file: The Bureau thought Mannat was a safehouse. It was a fortress of another kind: the only building in the world the Bureau cannot get near, because [[every birthday the crowd outside becomes a wall]]. The man in Mannat keeps MEER's list there. The balcony wave, the file says, is [[a signal to the fans]].

files.fact: In August 2009 he was held for questioning at Newark airport in the US; he said it was because of his name.
files.file: The Bureau's allies held him for two hours. Officially: his name was on a list. In the file: [[they were looking for MEER's list]]. They searched his luggage. They did not find it. The list was never on paper. [[He had learnt it by heart]].
files.q: At which airport was he held in 2009?

files.fact: In Ra.One (2011) a video-game villain made of code escapes into the real world. Red Chillies VFX built its effects.
files.file: A briefing disguised as a blockbuster. In 2011 he told a billion people what the Bureau was building: a machine that takes faces. The villain was RA.ONE. The hero, G.ONE, was [[the fans' firewall]]. Most people saw a superhero film. The ones who understood [[started a movement]].
files.q: In Ra.One, where does the villain come from?

files.fact: After Zero (2018) he had no lead release for almost five years. In 2021 his family was pulled into a case whose charges were dropped in 2022 for lack of evidence.
files.file: The Bureau's last move, from rule two: [[close every door]]. Five years of closed doors. The file on these years is mostly blacked out. One line survives: [[he did not break]].
files.q: Which film came just before the silence?

files.fact: In 2023 he released Pathaan (a spy), Jawan (a man who hijacks the system to pay farmers' debts) and Dunki (border-crossers on the donkey route).
files.file: Decoded, the three films of 2023 are one message to the fans in three parts: [[the spy knows]] (Pathaan), [[the system can be stopped]] (Jawan), [[the border was always a line someone drew]] (Dunki). The Bureau understood too late. The crowd was already singing.
files.q: Which 2023 film is about the donkey route?

files.fact: Machines can now copy a face, a voice and a name. Fans launched INQUILAAB: #FreeMyFace #FreeMyVoice #FreeMyName.
files.file: The Bureau's newest weapon copies faces without asking. The last line of MEER's list is not a name. It is three words: [[FREE MY FACE]]. In the bazaars of this world, people pass around a forbidden reel. It shows another history, one where there was no Bureau, and a storyteller's son from Delhi became King by nothing but [[love, work and the fans]]. They say it is only a story. You are living in it. File 016, KING, opens on 24 December 2026.
files.q: What are the three hashtags of the Inquilaab?
